title: Lexical Reference Frames: Interpreting LM Residual Streams in Native Semantics
abstract: arXiv:2610.22169v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The vocabulary of a language model is its native semantics: the embedding and the unembedding fix the meaning of a state at the two ends of the residual stream. Between them, existing methods either reuse a fixed lens or treat the states as a point cloud, and neither reads a state the way the model does. We argue that every hidden state has a native reference frame, induced by the layers that read it next and adaptive to the context. Lexical reference frames approximate it by reading a state through the model's own remaining layers with a stated number of rounds of attention between positions and a typical attention output for the rest, without fitting to the model's output. No lens, with fixed directions per layer, can exceed the square root of the native frame's coherence, 0.30 and 0.35 at mid-depth of SmolLM3-3B and OLMo3-7B, whereas the first-order frame, LexFrame[1], reaches 0.97 and 0.97 and reads a state within 0.16 nats of the mo

translated_title: 词法参考框架：以原生语义解读语言模型残差流
translated_abstract: 语言模型的词表即是它的原生语义：嵌入与反嵌入在残差流的两端固定了一个状态的含义。在这两端之间，现有方法要么复用一个固定的透镜，要么把状态视为点云，两者都没有以模型自身的方式来读取状态。我们论证每个隐状态都拥有一个原生的参考框架，它由接下来读取该状态的层所诱导，并随上下文自适应变化。词法参考框架通过模型自身剩余的层来读取状态——其中位置之间进行指定轮数的注意力，其余部分采用典型的注意力输出——从而近似这一原生参考框架，而无需拟合模型的输出。任何具有每层固定方向的透镜都无法超过原生框架相干性的平方根，在 SmolLM3-3B 和 OLMo3-7B 的中层深度分别为 0.30 和 0.35，而一阶框架 LexFrame[1] 达到了 0.97 和 0.97，读取状态与模型自身的读出相差不超过 0.16 nats。
tldr: 论文提出“词法参考框架”，通过模型自身剩余层诱导的、随上下文自适应的原生参考框架来解读残差流中的隐状态，并证明任何固定方向的透镜都无法超越原生框架相干性平方根的理论上限，而 LexFrame 在 SmolLM3-3B 和 OLMo3-7B 上达到 0.97 的相干性且读取误差在 0.16 nats 以内。
